server.title: Server
server.subtitle: Send audio from this computer to players on your network.
server.connectHint: Scan the QR code with Echoport on your phone, or type one of these addresses in the player.
server.notRunning: Start the server to accept players.
server.gainHint: Makes a quiet microphone louder. Very high values can distort.
noise.title: Noise suppression
noise.hint: Removes background noise such as keyboard typing, fans and hum. Uses more CPU.
player.title: Player
player.subtitle: Receive audio from a server and play it here.
player.searching: Looking for servers… Make sure the server is started and on the same network.
player.speaker: Speakers
player.speakerHint: Audio plays through this computer's speakers or headphones.
player.vmicHint: Audio goes into the virtual microphone. In Discord, Zoom or OBS pick “CABLE Output” as the microphone.
player.bufferHint: Lower = less delay, higher = fewer dropouts on weak Wi-Fi.
delay.title: Delay
delay.aria: Delay over the last minute: now {current} ms, average {avg} ms, highest {max} ms
delay.hint: Estimated time from the server to this computer: half the network ping + the buffer + one 5 ms audio frame. Your sound card adds a few milliseconds more. Lower the buffer for less delay; raise it if the sound cuts out.
player.pinNeeded: This server needs a PIN. Enter it and connect again.
vbcable.title: Virtual microphone needs VB-Cable
vbcable.body: VB-Cable is a free virtual audio driver. Install it once, restart Echoport, and the virtual microphone will work.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Device, appearance, startup and connection.
settings.launchAtLoginHint: Echoport opens automatically every time you turn on the computer.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
settings.autoReconnect: Reconnect to the last server automatically
settings.portHint: Change only if another app uses 47210. Restart the server to apply.
settings.requirePinHint: Players must type this PIN before they can listen.
settings.license: Free and open source under GPL-3.0.
